purpose.zh-Hant: 分清四心的定義，用等距、垂直與中點條件建立解法。
purpose.en: Distinguish the four centres and build solutions from equal distances, perpendicularity and midpoints.

prerequisites.zh-Hant: 三角形、中線／高線、畢氏定理與基本坐標。
prerequisites.en: Triangles, medians and altitudes, Pythagoras’ theorem and coordinates.

scopeNote.zh-Hant: 本頁提供基本方法導讀及現有題庫入口；進階分支與完整圖解會繼續補充，並非完整課綱或全章筆記。
scopeNote.en: This is a foundational method guide and an entry to the published bank. Advanced branches and complete visual explanations are still being developed; this is not a complete syllabus or chapter note.

intro.zh-Hant: 外心 O 是三邊中垂線的交點；內心 I 是三條內角平分線的交點；重心 G 是中線交點；垂心 H 是高線交點。
intro.en: The circumcentre O is the intersection of perpendicular bisectors; the incentre I is the intersection of internal angle bisectors; the centroid G is the intersection of medians; the orthocentre H is the intersection of altitudes.

trigger.zh-Hant: 先辨認題目給的是頂點距離、到邊距離、中點或垂直條件，再決定找哪個心。
trigger.en: Identify whether the givens concern distances to vertices, distances to sides, midpoints or perpendicularity before choosing a centre.

trap.zh-Hant: 內心的等距是到三邊所在直線的垂直距離，不是到三頂點的距離。
trap.en: The incentre is equidistant from the lines containing the sides, not from the vertices.

title.zh-Hant: 坐標法：用最短的兩條條件

intro.zh-Hant: 求外心可用兩組等距平方；求垂心可用兩條高線；重心直接取三頂點坐標平均。
intro.en: For the circumcentre, use two equal squared distances. For the orthocentre, use two altitudes. The centroid is the coordinate average of the vertices.

trigger.zh-Hant: 先檢查水平或垂直邊；遇到垂直線，可直接寫 x=常數，而不是套斜率相乘。
trigger.en: Check for horizontal or vertical sides first. Write a vertical line as x=constant rather than multiplying undefined slopes.

trap.zh-Hant: 高線經過頂點並垂直對邊；中垂線經過邊的中點，兩者不要混淆。
trap.en: An altitude passes through a vertex; a perpendicular bisector passes through a side midpoint. They are different lines.

title.zh-Hant: 特殊三角形與四心關係

intro.zh-Hant: 一般非等邊三角形的 O、G、H 在歐拉線上；I 通常不在這條線。等腰三角形四心在對稱軸上；等邊三角形四心重合。
intro.en: For a non-equilateral triangle, O, G and H lie on the Euler line; I does not generally lie on it. In an isosceles triangle all four centres lie on the symmetry axis; in an equilateral triangle they coincide.

trigger.zh-Hant: 先判斷三角形種類，再使用中心關係、面積或內外接半徑；s 是半周界。
trigger.en: Identify the triangle type before using centre relations, area or radii. Here s is the semiperimeter.

trap.zh-Hant: 鈍角三角形的外心與垂心可在三角形外；不能靠圖上看似在內就判斷。
trap.en: The circumcentre and orthocentre of an obtuse triangle can lie outside it. Do not decide from an informal sketch.
